scope: 固定隔离库只读诊断，非HTTP正式基准

sql.sql: SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ
START TRANSACTION READ ONLY
SELECT * FROM books WHERE id=?
SELECT * FROM book_members WHERE bookId=? AND userId=? AND status='ACTIVE'

SELECT e.id FROM expenses e JOIN expense_versions v ON v.expenseId=e.id AND v.revision=e.currentRevision AND v.bookId=e.bookId
      WHERE e.bookId=? ORDER BY v.occurredOn DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT 21

SELECT e.id,e.createdByMemberId,v.* FROM expenses e JOIN expense_versions v ON v.expenseId=e.id AND v.revision=e.currentRevision
    WHERE e.bookId=?  AND e.id IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ORDER BY v.occurredOn DESC,e.id DESC

SELECT s.expenseId,s.revision,s.memberId,s.amountFen FROM expense_shares s JOIN expenses e ON e.id=s.expenseId
    WHERE s.bookId=? AND s.revision=e.currentRevision  AND e.id IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ORDER BY s.memberId

START TRANSACTION READ ONLY
SELECT * FROM books WHERE id=?
SELECT * FROM book_members WHERE bookId=? AND userId=? AND status='ACTIVE'
SELECT m.id,m.userId,m.status,u.displayName FROM book_members m JOIN users u ON u.id=m.userId WHERE m.bookId=? ORDER BY m.id

SELECT r.*,t.id AS confirmedTransferId FROM transfer_requests r LEFT JOIN confirmed_transfers t ON t.requestId=r.id
    WHERE r.bookId=?  AND r.status='PENDING' ORDER BY r.createdAt DESC,r.id DESC

WITH current_expenses AS (
    SELECT e.id,e.currentRevision,v.paidByMemberId,v.amountFen FROM expenses e
    JOIN expense_versions v ON v.expenseId=e.id AND v.revision=e.currentRevision AND v.bookId=e.bookId
    WHERE e.bookId=? AND v.isVoided=0
  ), paid AS (SELECT paidByMemberId memberId,SUM(amountFen) paidFen FROM current_expenses GROUP BY paidByMemberId),
  shares AS (SELECT s.memberId,SUM(s.amountFen) shareFen FROM current_expenses v
    JOIN expense_shares s ON s.expenseId=v.id AND s.revision=v.currentRevision AND s.bookId=? GROUP BY s.memberId),
  outgoing AS (SELECT fromMemberId memberId,SUM(amountFen) outgoingFen FROM confirmed_transfers WHERE bookId=? GROUP BY fromMemberId),
  incoming AS (SELECT toMemberId memberId,SUM(amountFen) incomingFen FROM confirmed_transfers WHERE bookId=? GROUP BY toMemberId)
  SELECT m.id memberId,COALESCE(p.paidFen,0) paidFen,COALESCE(s.shareFen,0) shareFen,
    COALESCE(o.outgoingFen,0) outgoingFen,COALESCE(i.incomingFen,0) incomingFen
  FROM book_members m LEFT JOIN paid p ON p.memberId=m.id LEFT JOIN shares s ON s.memberId=m.id
    LEFT JOIN outgoing o ON o.memberId=m.id LEFT JOIN incoming i ON i.memberId=m.id WHERE m.bookId=? ORDER BY m.id

SELECT * FROM books WHERE id=?
SELECT * FROM book_members WHERE bookId=? AND userId=? AND status='ACTIVE'

WITH current_expenses AS (SELECT v.* FROM expenses e JOIN expense_versions v ON v.expenseId=e.id AND v.revision=e.currentRevision AND v.bookId=e.bookId WHERE e.bookId=? AND v.isVoided=0) SELECT category,SUM(amountFen) amountFen FROM current_expenses GROUP BY category

WITH current_expenses AS (SELECT v.* FROM expenses e JOIN expense_versions v ON v.expenseId=e.id AND v.revision=e.currentRevision AND v.bookId=e.bookId WHERE e.bookId=? AND v.isVoided=0),
    shares AS (SELECT s.memberId,SUM(s.amountFen) shareFen FROM current_expenses v JOIN expense_shares s ON s.bookId=v.bookId AND s.expenseId=v.expenseId AND s.revision=v.revision GROUP BY s.memberId),
    paid AS (SELECT paidByMemberId memberId,SUM(amountFen) paidFen FROM current_expenses GROUP BY paidByMemberId)
    SELECT m.id memberId,COALESCE(p.paidFen,0) paidFen,COALESCE(s.shareFen,0) shareFen,
      DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(s.shareFen,0) DESC) rankNo
    FROM book_members m LEFT JOIN shares s ON s.memberId=m.id LEFT JOIN paid p ON p.memberId=m.id
    WHERE m.bookId=? ORDER BY rankNo,m.id
